Name: Bloom Again (Flower Crafting and Recipes)
Author: ohitslunette
Description:
[quote][font=Courier New][size=5][color=#ffe599]Make Granny Evelyn even prouder [/color][color=#b4a7d6]🎕[/color][/size][/font][/quote]
[b][color=#ea9999]Bloom Again[/color][/b] adds new crafting items, food + drink recipes, clothing, and furniture items to the valley. No longer do you need to just watch your flowers come and go with the seasons. As you befriend your neighbors (namely Leah, Evelyn, and Emily at this time) and progress through the game, you'll learn ways to further use your flowers after harvest. You can discover your fellow villagers' gift tastes for these items and even see some unique gift responses.

[size=3][color=#b6d7a8]How to Press Flowers
[/color]
[/size]To press flowers for crafting and cooking, you need to place six (6) of them into a Flower Press. After completing a quest with Leah, you'll be able to get the recipe to build one from Robin's shop. For an alternative pressing method, build friendship with Evelyn, and she'll teach you how to press flowers from the comfort of your kitchen. All you'll need is a book.

[size=3][color=#b6d7a8]Some things I want to add in the future include...[/color]
[/size]
[list]
[*]More item options for vanilla flowers
[*]Fashion Sense version of clothing items
[*]Gift tastes for SVE characters (I'd love to add these for other custom NPCs as well (with permission))
[/list]
[b][color=#ffe599]And if time and strength allow...[/color]

[/b][list]
[*]Add event(s) tied to making things with flowers
[*]Include modded flower objects from Cornucopia and SVE
[*]Add even more items to make with flowers
[/list]
[size=3][color=#b6d7a8]Installation Instructions[/color]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI [/b]and [b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*]Make sure you have this mod's requirements: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs (EMC)[/url]﻿
[*]Download the latest version of this mod from the Files tab, and unzip it to your Mods folder
[*]You should be good to go [color=#b4a7d6]❀[/color]
[/list]
[size=3][color=#b6d7a8]Highly Recommended Mods[/color]
[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38862]Flexible Cooking[/url]﻿, to use more flower options when cooking
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42801]Merchant[/url]﻿, to make the flower craft shop of your dreams [color=#ea9999]°[/color][color=#b4a7d6]❀[/color][color=#ea9999]⋆[/color][color=#ffe599]*[/color][color=#ea9999]:[/color][color=#f4cccc]･[/color]
[size=2][/size][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14061]Wild Flowers[/url]﻿, so you have no shortage of flowers to work with
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44109]Quaint Living (Buildings)[/url]﻿, so your farmhouse fits with your floral items
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44202]Stardew Valley Flower Show[/url]﻿, to further celebrate the valley's flowers
[/list]
[size=3][color=#b6d7a8]Compatibility
[/color]
[/size]If you have Flexible Cooking installed, you should be able to use flexible ingredients (i.e any flower of a specific type) when cooking. Also, if you have Object Categories, you can even press Dandelions and Daffodils when their category is changed from 'Forage to 'Flower'.
